title: Monte Carlo Approximations of Time-Nonlocal Diffusions in Bounded Domains
summary: We develop and analyze a Monte Carlo method for sampling killed anomalous diffusions obtained by time-changing Brownian motion with drift by the inverse of a subordinator. The method targets probabilistic representations of time-nonlocal, including time-fractional, Cauchy--Dirichlet problems on bounded domains. Since inverse subordinators can be sampled exactly in broad classes, while Brownian exit times are generally unavailable in arbitrary domains, we approximate the killed Brownian component by an Euler scheme with discrete boundary detection.
